Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The function of a deaerating
heater is to remove non-condensable gases and to heat boiler feed water, a
deaerating heater consists of a press. Vessel in which water and steam are
mixed with controlled velocities
The technical specification of the 
Deaerating Heater: Qty = 4
Type of deaerating heater: | Horizontal tray
Operating press.: | 200 Psi
Outlet capacity per unit: | 2,481,669 LBS/hr
Number of spray valves: | 64
Number of distributing
 trays: | 14
Number of deaerating trays: | 450
The first draft initiated by eng.
Tarek Abd Elmonem Mahmoud, revised
by eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Shaker, approved by eng. Mohamed Helmy Habib general 
director, accepted by eng. Mohamed El-tahawy Mostafa Head sector of Shoubra
El-Khimah PS 4x315MW.
This document certified by eng. 
Afaf Ebrahim Eldib CEPC inspection and quality control head sector MPIS 
Coordinator and reviewed by eng. Nageh Soliman Shoosha .
Safety Precaution
Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker 
for electrical equipments
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker 
for electrical equipments
Tools and Equipment
Standard tool set
Electric lights
Work to be Carried out

deaerator.
Inspect spray valve box for broken
welds and cracks.
Inspect spray valve for broken
spring or bolts.
Inspect for corrosion and scaling.
Inspect trays for debris and
tightness.
